transcript.en: It's great to see so many members of the Twinning Association here tonight.
transcript.zh: 很高兴今晚在这里看到这么多友好城市协会的成员。

transcript.en: Since the twinning link between our two towns, Stanthorpe here in England and Malatte in France, was established, the relationship between the towns has gone from strength to strength.
transcript.zh: 自从英国的斯坦索普镇和法国的马拉特镇结成姊妹镇以来，两镇之间的关系日益密切。

transcript.en: Last month, 25 members of the association from Stanthorpe spent a weekend in Malatte.
transcript.zh: 上个月，斯坦索普的 25 名协会成员在马拉特度过了一个周末。

transcript.en: Our hosts had arranged a great programme.
transcript.zh: 东道主为我们安排了精彩的活动。

transcript.en: We learned how cheese is produced in the region and had the chance to taste the products.
transcript.zh: 我们了解了该地区奶酪的生产过程并有机会品尝了奶酪。

transcript.en: The theme park trip had to be cancelled, but we all had a great time on the final boat trip down the river – that was the real highlight.
transcript.zh: 主题公园之旅不得不取消，但我们在最后的乘船游河活动中都度过了美好时光——这是那次访问的真正高潮。

transcript.en: This is a special year for the Association because it’s 25 years since we were founded.
transcript.zh: 今年对协会来说是一个特殊的年份，因为今年是协会成立的第 25 周年。

transcript.en: In Malatte, they're planning to mark this by building a footbridge in the municipal park.
transcript.zh: 在马拉特，他们计划在市政公园修建一座人行桥以表纪念。

transcript.en: We've been discussing what to do here and we’ve decided to plant a poplar tree in the museum gardens.
transcript.zh: 我们一直在讨论我们斯坦索普镇应该做些什么，最后决定在博物馆花园里种植一棵白杨树。

transcript.en: We considered buying a garden seat to put there, but the authorities weren’t happy with that idea.
transcript.zh: 我们考虑过买一个花园座椅放在那里，但上级对这个想法并不满意。

transcript.en: In terms of fundraising to support our activities, we’ve done very well.
transcript.zh: 在活动筹款方面，我们做得非常好。

transcript.en: Our pancake evening was well attended and made record profits. And everyone enjoyed the demonstration of French cookery, which was nearly as successful.
transcript.zh: 我们的煎饼晚会参加人数众多，利润创下新高。法式烹饪的演示也很成功，大家都很喜欢。

transcript.en: Numbers for our film show were limited because of the venue so we’re looking for somewhere bigger next year.
transcript.zh: 由于场地原因，参加电影放映活动的人数有限，因此我们明年打算寻找更大的场地。

transcript.en: We're looking forward to welcoming our French visitors here next week, and I know that many of you here will be hosting individuals or families.
transcript.zh: 我们期待着下周在这里迎接我们的法国客人，我知道在座的许多人都将接待个人或家庭。

transcript.en: The coach from France will arrive at 5 pm on Friday.
transcript.zh: 来自法国的旅游巴士将于周五下午5点到达。

transcript.en: Don't try to do too much that first evening as they’ll be tired, so have dinner in the house or garden rather than eating out.
transcript.zh: 第一天晚上不要做太多事情，因为客人们应该会很累，所以晚餐不要在外面吃，可以在家里或花园里吃。

transcript.en: The weather looks as if it’ll be OK so you might like to plan a barbecue.
transcript.zh: 天气看起来还不错，所以可以计划进行烧烤。

transcript.en: Then the next morning’s market day in town, and that’s always a good place to stroll round.
transcript.zh: 然后就是镇上的集市日，那里总是散步的好地方。

transcript.en: On Saturday evening, we’ll all meet up at the football club, where once again we’ll have Toby Sharp and his band performing English and Scottish country songs.
transcript.zh: 周六晚上，我们将在足球俱乐部集合，届时托比·夏普和他的乐队将再次为我们带来英国和苏格兰乡村歌曲。

transcript.en: Toby will already be well known to many of you as last year he organised our special quiz night and presented the prizes.
transcript.zh: 许多人应该都很熟悉托比了，去年他组织了我们的特别问答之夜并颁发了奖品。

transcript.en: Now on Sunday, we’ll be taking our visitors to Farley House. You may not all be familiar with it, so here’s a map to help you.
transcript.zh: 星期日，我们将带游客参观法雷利之家。也许你们对它并不熟悉，下面是一张地图，可以帮助你们。

transcript.en: You can see the car park at the bottom of the map. There's an excellent farm shop in the grounds where our visitors can buy local produce – it's in the old stables, which is the first building you come to.
transcript.zh: 在地图底部可以找到停车场。院子里有一家很不错的农家商店，游客可以在那里购买当地特产——商店就在老马厩里，也就是我们将会见到的第一座建筑。

transcript.en: They're built round a courtyard, and the shop’s in the far corner on the left.
transcript.zh: 马厩围绕一个庭院而建，商店就在最左边的角落里。

transcript.en: There's also a small café on the right as you go in.
transcript.zh: 进门右侧还有一家小咖啡馆。

transcript.en: I know that one or two of our visitors may not be all that mobile.
transcript.zh: 我知道有一两个游客可能行动不便。

transcript.en: The main entrance to the house has a lot of steps so you might want to use the disabled entry.
transcript.zh: 但房子的正门有很多台阶，所以你们可能需要使用残疾人入口。

transcript.en: This is on the far side of the house from the car park.
transcript.zh: 这个入口位于房子离停车场远的那一边。

transcript.en: Children will probably be most interested in the adventure playground.
transcript.zh: 孩子们最感兴趣的可能是冒险游乐场。

transcript.en: That's at the northern  end of the larger lake, in a bend on the path that leads to the lake.
transcript.zh: 它位于大湖的北端，在通往湖边那条小路的一个拐弯处。

transcript.en: There's lots for children to do there. There are a number of lovely gardens near the house. The kitchen gardens are rectangular and surrounded by a wall.
transcript.zh: 那里有很多供孩子们玩耍的地方。房子附近有许多可爱的花园。厨房花园呈长方形，四周有围墙。

transcript.en: They're to the north-east of the house, quite near the smaller lake.
transcript.zh: 它们坐落在房子的东北方向，离小湖很近。

transcript.en: They're still in use and have a great collection of fruit and vegetables.
transcript.zh: 花园仍在使用，里面有很多水果和蔬菜。

transcript.en: The Temple of the Four Winds is a bit more of a walk – but it's worth it.
transcript.zh: 四风庙需要走一段路，但值得一去。

transcript.en: Take the path from the car park and go past the western sides of the stables and the house.
transcript.zh: 从停车场出来，经过马厩和房屋的西侧。

transcript.en: Then when the path forks, take the right-hand path. Go up there with the woods on your left and the temple is right at the end.
transcript.zh: 当道路分叉时，走右边的那条路。沿着那条路走，左边是树林，寺庙就在路的尽头。

transcript.en: There are great views over the whole area. OK, so that's . . .
transcript.zh: 从这里可以俯瞰整个地区。好了，这就是......
